S1_S7_drafts.name: Deterministic Command
S1_S7_drafts.draft_semantics: Bind stable logical operation/command, actor/subject, action/scope/resource/environment, expected revision, schema/policy/registry, correlation and deterministic effective-input fingerprint. IDs are never authority.
S1_S7_drafts.unready: Existing RPCs and M1/checkpoint fields carry part of this meaning; no uniform command/environment/policy/registry binding proved for every consumer.

S1_S7_drafts.name: Idempotency / Retry Safety
S1_S7_drafts.draft_semantics: Durable scope/key/fingerprint maps to one canonical result and original receipt; committed retries do not mutate; in-progress never duplicates effects; uncertain completion is reconciled before any retry.
S1_S7_drafts.unready: Checkpoint exact-payload repair has scoped real PG evidence. Exactly 10 repeats, lost-response and external-effect boundaries are not yet exercised as ST cases. Duplicate response currently identifies checkpoint/version but does not return original receipt_id.

S1_S7_drafts.name: Revision CAS / Concurrency Safety
S1_S7_drafts.draft_semantics: Updates require exact revision, creates require absence/uniqueness, stale writers conflict; authorization/CAS/invariant/commit share a defined safe boundary.
S1_S7_drafts.unready: Checkpoint null/negative base now rejected and normal CAS exists. Distinct-key writers on one revision and mid-operation revoke/kill boundaries need actual targeted evidence.

S1_S7_drafts.name: Canonical State Machine & Invariants
S1_S7_drafts.draft_semantics: Per-object allowed states/transitions, preconditions, terminal boundaries, authority and evidence; forbid guessed state and silent overwrite. Prefer transactional constraints.
S1_S7_drafts.unready: Existing M1 lifecycle validation is partial reuse, not proof of all target consumers/objects. Extracted candidate and source-withdrawal propagation remain capability-map gaps.

S1_S7_drafts.name: Receipt / Replay / Traceability
S1_S7_drafts.draft_semantics: Bind original operation/command, actor/subject, authorization, target, pre/post revisions and states, policy/registry, transition/result/commit/correlation. Replay verifies history without new effects.
S1_S7_drafts.unready: Existing receipts and preserved old checkpoint receipts are real. Complete new minimum field mapping, original receipt reference on checkpoint duplicate response, failed receipt persistence and external durable intent/outbox are not fully demonstrated.

S1_S7_drafts.name: Fail-Closed & Blast-Radius Control
S1_S7_drafts.draft_semantics: Use only existing pre-authorized deny/read-only/disable/pause/revoke/isolate; scope by environment/resource/action/consumer/principal/worker/projection. Uncertainty never grants authority.
S1_S7_drafts.unready: Existing scope/revocation/feature gates are reusable, not new containment authority. Whole-consumer boundary inventory and exact containment/recovery authorization remain to be bound; no global hard deny is introduced.

S1_S7_drafts.name: Stability Signals & Repairability
S1_S7_drafts.draft_semantics: Feed existing HealthFinding/FindingSeverity semantics; collect scoped duplicate/retry/CAS/state/auth/receipt/projection/safe-state metrics and false positives; no automatic repair or new severity system.
S1_S7_drafts.unready: HS0 is preparation only. No formal R11/HS1 sample, detector, SLO, HS2 drill or Repairability result exists in these reused artifacts. Step12–14 Local Warning is not R11.
